saw_lines: Parents buy learning toys by age stage, then add figures over time, so the set that fits this year’s age wins.
So the sale is decided in the opening line, where a parent checks the age and the price before reading on.
Your 12 of 24 copy ads open on “3 Figuren kaufen, nur 2 bezahlen” line, so run two or three new angles from your own figures against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: 12 of your 24 copy ads open on “3 Figuren kaufen, nur 2 bezahlen”, so a parent sees one line again and again. Write two new openers built on the age stage each set fits, and test them beside it.

Your shipping policy page answers the question, yet none of your 29 ads answer it up front, so a new parent hesitates before clicking. Put free shipping from 50 euro in the opening line of ads aimed at first-time buyers.
The offer appears after 85% of the copy on a median ad of 98 words, so many parents never reach it. Move the bundle offer into the first two lines of each ad, since only 2 of 24 ads mention it.
One exact copy runs in 12 of 24 ads, so parents read the same story again and again. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad, so every version gives a reason to look again.

ads_1: Age-stage openers built around the bundle, tested against the 3 for 2 line
